title: Resolver Phase B: receiver capture + Dart constructor type tracking
description:
Phase B of scope-aware resolution (Phase A = sutra/230, Phase 0 = sutra/254). Enables `final x = Foo(); x.bar()` resolution — currently structurally impossible because ExtractedRef {name, line, col, context_kind} (parser/mod.rs:126-131) has NO receiver field in any language; rust.rs even has tests (receiver_not_extracted L1027, plain_field_access_no_method_ref L1057) asserting the receiver is dropped.

Plan:
1. Add receiver: Option<String> to ExtractedRef. Touches all four extractors (rust.rs, dart.rs, python.rs, c.rs) — capture the receiver identifier text for method-call/field-access refs. Update the rust.rs tests that assert dropping (they become capture tests). One coordinated change, done once here.
2. Dart constructor tracking in the Phase A scope arena (extended to dart.rs): assignment forms `final x = Foo(...)`, `var x = Foo(...)`, `X x = Foo(...)` record Scope.types[x] = "Foo" (sem's AssignmentStrategy::LeftRight/Declarators analogues — languages.rs:159-175 for the pattern catalog, architecture only).
3. Method resolution: ref with receiver `x` + tracked type Foo → look up member in a class_members map: HashMap<class_qualified_name, Vec<(member_short_name, symbol_id)>> built from persisted parent_symbol_id chains — this is sutra's PreBuiltLookups analogue, built once in post_parse_sequence alongside the Phase A symbol_table, shared by reference. `this.`/`self.` special case: walk up to nearest enclosing class symbol.
4. Resolution provenance: these edges stamp resolution_method="type_tracking" (column added in Phase A).

Reference (architecture, not port): sem scope_resolve.rs Scope.types + lookup_type_in_scopes (L6650-6660), MethodCall handling (~L6082-6140), class_members in PreBuiltLookups (L399-407).

Tests: dart fixture `final c = Cache(); c.get(...)` resolves to Cache.get not a same-named global; reassignment updates tracked type; untracked receiver falls through to existing heuristics unchanged; rust receiver capture doesn't alter existing rust resolution results (receiver captured but unused until rust type tracking).

decisions.rationale: Reuses the existing parse-time hint channel; no schema change to ExtractedRef beyond receiver. Resolver already switches on hint prefixes (LOCAL_BINDING_SENTINEL). Keeps the data flow uniform.
rejected_alternatives: Add a separate `tracked_class: Option<String>` field to ExtractedRef — more explicit but doubles the optional fields and requires more DB columns
decisions.summary: Use TYPE_TRACKING_PREFIX sentinel in resolved_local_target rather than a new ExtractedRef field

execution_record: The grammar mismatch was the main surprise: `collect_dart_type_bindings` initially only matched `initialized_identifier` (used for comma-separated additional variables in a list), but local declarations like `final c = Cache()` parse as `initialized_variable_definition` in tree-sitter-dart. Adding that second kind to the match fixed all 4 failing parse-dart tests. The no-clone-driven-dev constraint forced restructuring `build_class_members` to borrow `&str` from `all_symbols` with an explicit `ClassMembers<'a>` lifetime alias instead of cloning short_name strings — filed waiver 146 during the work. All 1251 tests pass; 446 lines added across 15 files.

messages.text: Review: approve with notes. Change is correct and well-tested. Two findings to file as follow-ups: (1) HIGH: replace_refs_and_clear_resolution drops receiver + resolved_local_target on re-resolution (pre-existing, also affects Phase A scope hints); (2) MEDIUM: build_class_members is rebuilt per-file in the resolution loop — should be lifted to post_parse_sequence. Two low items: scope-unaware lookup_receiver_type, named constructor class name extraction.

messages.author: agent
messages.text:
All four review findings fixed in 805c262:

1. **re-resolution-loses-hints (HIGH)**: `replace_refs_and_clear_resolution` now uses a `ResolvedRefRow` struct that preserves `resolved_local_target` and `receiver` through the DELETE+INSERT cycle. Re-resolution after dependency changes now retains scope-chain and type-tracking hints.

2. **class-members-rebuilt-per-file (MEDIUM)**: `build_class_members` is now public, called once in `post_parse_sequence`, and passed into `resolve_file_refs`/`resolve_refs`. Eliminates O(N×S) redundant work.

3. **lookup-not-scope-aware (LOW)**: `DartTypeBinding` now carries `scope_end_line` (enclosing function boundary). `lookup_receiver_type` filters by `ref_line <= scope_end_line`, preventing bindings from leaking across sibling functions. New test: `type_tracking_scope_boundary_prevents_cross_function_leak`.

4. **named-constructor-class-name (LOW)**: `dart_constructor_type` now handles `member_expression` function nodes (e.g. `Cache.fromJson()`), extracting the object identifier as the class name. New test: `type_tracking_named_constructor`.

1253 tests pass (2 new).
